The 27-city North American run began September 27 in Minneapolis and wraps November 30 in Vancouver. Tickets are available through Ticketmaster.

games.name: Erykah Badu & The Alchemist - Cleveland
games.developer: Erykah Badu, The Alchemist, De La Soul
games.description: Erykah Badu and producer The Alchemist play Jacobs Pavilion on the Cleveland riverfront on September 15, 2026, with De La Soul on the bill. The fall co-headline run is tied to the pair's long-teased collaborative album, recorded over roughly eighteen months in Dallas and Los Angeles. The tour opened September 10 at Ravinia Festival in Illinois and finishes September 29 at the Hollywood Bowl.

games.name: Erykah Badu & The Alchemist - Queens
games.developer: Erykah Badu, The Alchemist, De La Soul
games.description: Erykah Badu and The Alchemist headline Forest Hills Stadium at the West Side Tennis Club in Queens on September 18, 2026, the New York stop of their fall co-headline tour. De La Soul appear in support. The run previews the duo's joint album, which arrives August 28 via Control FREAQ Records and Young Recordings after roughly eighteen months of sessions in Dallas and Los Angeles.

games.name: Erykah Badu & The Alchemist - Los Angeles
games.developer: Erykah Badu, The Alchemist, De La Soul, Smino
games.description: Erykah Badu and The Alchemist close their 2026 North American tour at the Hollywood Bowl on September 29, with De La Soul and Smino joining the bill. The Los Angeles finale caps a September run that began at Ravinia Festival and passed through Detroit, Toronto, Cleveland, New York, Denver and Berkeley, spotlighting the duo's newly released collaborative album.

games.name: Jamila Woods: 10 Years of HEAVN - Portland
games.description: Jamila Woods brings her 10 Years of HEAVN tour to Wonder Ballroom in Portland on November 19, 2026. The short six-city run marks a decade since the Chicago poet and singer released her debut album HEAVN, and travels from Los Angeles through San Francisco, Portland, Seattle and Brooklyn before a hometown finale at Thalia Hall on December 6.

games.name: Allison Russell: In the Hour of Chaos Tour - Boston
games.description: Allison Russell plays Royale in Boston on October 18, 2026 on her fall North American headline tour. The 20-date run supports In the Hour of Chaos, her third solo album, released in July 2026 with contributions from Norah Jones, Brittney Spencer, Joy Oladokun and Kara Jackson. Elisapie and AHI join as special guests on selected dates.

games.name: Allison Russell: In the Hour of Chaos Tour - Seattle
games.description: Allison Russell performs at The Showbox in Seattle on November 11, 2026, near the end of her fall North American headline tour. The 20-date itinerary opened October 15 in Asheville and closes November 15 in Berkeley, California. It supports In the Hour of Chaos, the Montreal-born singer-songwriter's heavily collaborative third solo album released in July 2026.

games.name: Bourbon & Beyond 2026
platforms: Highland Festival Grounds at Kentucky Exposition Center, Louisville, KY
games.developer: Foo Fighters, Queens of the Stone Age, Mumford & Sons, Kacey Musgraves, Chris Stapleton, Dave Matthews Band
games.description: Bourbon & Beyond returns to the Highland Festival Grounds at the Kentucky Exposition Center in Louisville from September 24 to 27, 2026 for its eighth edition. Danny Wimmer Presents has assembled the largest lineup in festival history, with more than 100 artists across five stages alongside bourbon tastings and chef demonstrations. Day-by-day set times were published in August ahead of the four-day run.

games.name: Rock The Bells Festival 2026
games.developer: LL Cool J, SWV, Method Man & Redman, Lil' Kim, D-Nice, The LOX, LeToya Luckett, David Banner
games.publisher: Rock The Bells / Black Promoters Collective
games.description: Rock The Bells Festival returns to the Prudential Center in Newark on Sunday, November 29, 2026, closing Hip-Hop History Month over Thanksgiving weekend. Founder LL Cool J headlines alongside SWV, Method Man & Redman and Lil' Kim, plus a D-Nice-curated set featuring LeToya Luckett, David Banner and The LOX. Further additions are promised in the weeks ahead.

games.name: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard - Alien Metal
games.description: Alien Metal is the twenty-eighth studio album by Australian band King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, surprise released on August 14, 2026 through the group's own p(doom) Records a day after it was confirmed. Announced in July alongside lead single Level 5, the record pushes the rave and techno direction the band had been developing live with their modular synth rig, following the singles Alien Metal and Kill for the Steel.

games.name: Erykah Badu & The Alchemist - Collaborative Album
games.description: Erykah Badu and producer The Alchemist release their long-delayed joint album digitally on August 28, 2026 via Control FREAQ Records and Young Recordings. The pair recorded it over roughly eighteen months in Dallas and Los Angeles, and the announcement arrived with the single Witch Doctor, following earlier previews Next to You and Echos 19. A formal title and cover art had not been revealed at announcement, with the Bandcamp listing left deliberately untitled.

games.name: Brandi Carlile - Returning To Myself (Sad Gay Version)
games.description: Brandi Carlile releases Returning To Myself (Sad Gay Version) on September 25, 2026 through Interscope Records and Lost Highway. The 21-track expanded edition reworks all ten songs from the original album in a quieter register, with four tracks co-produced at Long Pond Studio in upstate New York alongside Aaron Dessner of The National. A new reading of Human featuring Jon Hopkins was shared as a first preview.

games.name: Claud - Me and the Music
games.description: Me and the Music is the third studio album from Brooklyn singer-songwriter Claud, due October 23, 2026 on Dead Oceans. It is their first full-length since 2023's Supermodels, and was announced in August alongside the lead single She Doesn't Love Me and an accompanying music video. Pre-orders opened at announcement through the label and independent record shops.

games.name: Lorna Shore: I Feel The Everblack Festering Within Me - London
games.developer: Lorna Shore, Whitechapel, Shadow of Intent, Humanity's Last Breath
games.description: Lorna Shore headlined a sold-out Alexandra Palace in north London on February 8, 2026, the biggest UK date of their I Feel The Everblack Festering Within Me tour. Humanity's Last Breath, Shadow of Intent and Whitechapel filled out the bill from 6:30pm, and the New Jersey deathcore band took the stage at 9:20pm. The set drew on the new album alongside the Pain Remains trilogy and closed with To the Hellfire.

games.name: An Evening With PinkPantheress - London
games.description: PinkPantheress played a sold-out Alexandra Palace on May 29, 2026 on the UK and European leg of her An Evening With PinkPantheress tour, with iKeda opening. The London show followed her Producer of the Year win at the 2026 BRIT Awards and drew reviews praising a theatrical production of choreography, costume changes and intricate lighting that scaled her bedroom-pop songs up to an arena-sized room.

games.name: Lord Huron: The Cosmic Selector Tour - St. Augustine
platforms: St. Augustine Amphitheatre, St. Augustine, FL
games.description: Lord Huron played the St. Augustine Amphitheatre in northern Florida on July 27, 2026 as part of The Cosmic Selector Tour. Doors opened at six and the show began at seven, running close to two hours. The Los Angeles indie folk band drew on the album that gave the tour its name alongside older material such as The Night We Met and Ends of the Earth.

games.name: The Black Keys: Peaches 'n Kream World Tour - St. Augustine
platforms: St. Augustine Amphitheatre, St. Augustine, FL
games.description: The Black Keys performed at the St. Augustine Amphitheatre on July 29, 2026 on their Peaches 'n Kream World Tour '26, with Atlanta blues guitarist Eddie 9V opening. Doors opened at 5:30pm and the Akron duo of Dan Auerbach and Patrick Carney started at seven, working through catalogue staples including Lonely Boy, Gold on the Ceiling and Tighten Up.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Philadelphia
games.description: The Jonas Brothers bring The Burning Up Tour All Over Again to Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia on October 2, 2026, one of 45 North American arena stops on the Live Nation run that grew out of their sold-out Madison Square Garden celebrations in August 2026. The show revisits the 2008 Burning Up Tour that broke Kevin, Joe and Nick Jonas nationally, rebuilt for arenas nearly two decades later. Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa joins as support.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Indianapolis
games.description: The Jonas Brothers bring The Burning Up Tour All Over Again to Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis on October 15, 2026, one of 45 North American arena stops on the Live Nation run that grew out of their sold-out Madison Square Garden celebrations in August 2026. The show revisits the 2008 Burning Up Tour that broke Kevin, Joe and Nick Jonas nationally, rebuilt for arenas nearly two decades later. Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa joins as support.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Rosemont
games.description: The Jonas Brothers bring The Burning Up Tour All Over Again to Allstate Arena in Rosemont on October 22, 2026, one of 45 North American arena stops on the Live Nation run that grew out of their sold-out Madison Square Garden celebrations in August 2026. The show revisits the 2008 Burning Up Tour that broke Kevin, Joe and Nick Jonas nationally, rebuilt for arenas nearly two decades later. Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa joins as support.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Los Angeles
games.developer: Jonas Brothers, All Time Low, Magnus Ferrell, Deleasa
games.description: The Jonas Brothers bring The Burning Up Tour All Over Again to Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles on November 18, 2026, one of 45 North American arena stops on the Live Nation run that grew out of their sold-out Madison Square Garden celebrations in August 2026. The show revisits the 2008 Burning Up Tour that broke Kevin, Joe and Nick Jonas nationally, rebuilt for arenas nearly two decades later. All Time Low, Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa joins as support.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Denver
games.description: The Jonas Brothers bring The Burning Up Tour All Over Again to Ball Arena in Denver on December 9, 2026, one of 45 North American arena stops on the Live Nation run that grew out of their sold-out Madison Square Garden celebrations in August 2026. The show revisits the 2008 Burning Up Tour that broke Kevin, Joe and Nick Jonas nationally, rebuilt for arenas nearly two decades later. Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa joins as support.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Belmont Park
games.description: The Jonas Brothers bring The Burning Up Tour All Over Again to UBS Arena in Belmont Park on December 19, 2026, one of 45 North American arena stops on the Live Nation run that grew out of their sold-out Madison Square Garden celebrations in August 2026. The show revisits the 2008 Burning Up Tour that broke Kevin, Joe and Nick Jonas nationally, rebuilt for arenas nearly two decades later. Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa joins as support.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Newark
games.description: The Jonas Brothers bring The Burning Up Tour All Over Again to Prudential Center in Newark on December 21, 2026, one of 45 North American arena stops on the Live Nation run that grew out of their sold-out Madison Square Garden celebrations in August 2026. The show revisits the 2008 Burning Up Tour that broke Kevin, Joe and Nick Jonas nationally, rebuilt for arenas nearly two decades later. Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa joins as support. The Newark date closes the tour.

games.name: TAEMIN World Tour <LiMiNaL> - Los Angeles
games.description: SHINee member and solo artist TAEMIN plays Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles on October 15, 2026 as part of the 2026-27 LiMiNaL World Tour, his first run routed with a major Western promoter after partnering with AEG. The tour follows his Coachella debut in April 2026 and the album Phase 1 : SOFT VIOLENCE, and moves him from theatre-sized rooms into full arenas. The leg opens October 12 at SAP Center in San Jose.

games.name: TAEMIN World Tour <LiMiNaL> - Newark
games.description: SHINee member and solo artist TAEMIN plays Prudential Center in Newark on October 23, 2026 as part of the 2026-27 LiMiNaL World Tour, his first run routed with a major Western promoter after partnering with AEG. The tour follows his Coachella debut in April 2026 and the album Phase 1 : SOFT VIOLENCE, and moves him from theatre-sized rooms into full arenas. The Newark show closes the six-city North American leg.

games.name: Bad Bunny: Debi Tirar Mas Fotos - Cerramos en Casa (Night 1)
platforms: Hiram Bithorn Stadium, San Juan, Puerto Rico
games.description: Bad Bunny closes the Debi Tirar Mas Fotos World Tour with two hometown nights at Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, and this is the first of them. The billing, Cerramos en Casa, translates as we close at home, bringing the global run back to the Puerto Rico residency that started the album cycle in 2025. Tickets went on sale August 19 through PR Ticket.

games.name: Bad Bunny: Debi Tirar Mas Fotos - Cerramos en Casa (Night 2)
platforms: Hiram Bithorn Stadium, San Juan, Puerto Rico
games.description: Bad Bunny closes the Debi Tirar Mas Fotos World Tour with two hometown nights at Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, and this is the second and final of them. The billing, Cerramos en Casa, translates as we close at home, bringing the global run back to the Puerto Rico residency that started the album cycle in 2025. Tickets went on sale August 19 through PR Ticket.

games.name: Yuri & Lucero: Entre Amigas Tour - Newark
games.description: Mexican pop veterans Yuri and Lucero share a stage for the first time on the Entre Amigas Tour, and the Newark date at Prudential Center on May 9, 2027 closes the US itinerary. The run opens November 27, 2026 in Sugar Land, Texas, pauses, then resumes in April 2027 through San Jose, Los Angeles, Chicago and Fairfax. General tickets went on sale August 21, 2026.

games.name: TAEMIN - PHASE 1 : SOFT VIOLENCE
games.description: TAEMIN releases PHASE 1 : SOFT VIOLENCE worldwide on August 31, 2026, his first full-length body of work in roughly two years and his first under Galaxy Corporation. The eleven-track set includes FLOAT, Gooey, PERMISSION, 1004, SKIN, PARASITE, Frankenstein and This is the End, moving between atmospheric pop and moodier experimental production. It lands ahead of the LiMiNaL World Tour opening in Seoul on September 18.

games.name: Louder Than Life 2025
platforms: Highland Festival Grounds at Kentucky Exposition Center, Louisville, KY
games.developer: Slayer, Rob Zombie, Avenged Sevenfold, Deftones, Bring Me the Horizon, Sleep Token
games.description: Louder Than Life ran September 18-21, 2025 at the Highland Festival Grounds at the Kentucky Exposition Center in Louisville. Danny Wimmer Presents billed it as the largest lineup in the promoter's history, with more than 175 bands across seven stages. Slayer, Rob Zombie, Avenged Sevenfold, Deftones and Bring Me the Horizon took the headline slots, with Sleep Token, Bad Omens and $uicideboy$ also billed high.

games.name: Alex G: Headlights Tour - New York
platforms: Radio City Music Hall, New York, NY
games.description: Alex G played Radio City Music Hall on October 8, 2025, an added New York date on the tour behind Headlights, the Philadelphia songwriter's major-label debut released that July on RCA. Nilufer Yanya opened. The booking was a sharp jump in room size for an artist who had spent a decade in clubs and mid-size theatres, and the set drew across the new record and the older catalogue.

games.name: Laufey: A Matter of Time Tour - Los Angeles
games.description: Laufey opened a two-night stand at Crypto.com Arena on September 26, 2025 on the A Matter of Time Tour, her first headline arena dates. Suki Waterhouse supported. The Icelandic-Chinese singer built the show around jazz-rooted material staged with pop production values, and brought out Hozier for a duet during the opening night. She returned to the same building the following evening.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Los Angeles
games.developer: Jonas Brothers, All Time Low, Magnus Ferrell, Deleasa
games.description: The Jonas Brothers bring The Burning Up Tour All Over Again to the Hollywood Bowl on November 18, 2026. The trek revives their 2008-09 Burning Up Tour, rebuilding that set list and staging alongside later catalogue hits across 47 North American dates. All Time Low join Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa as openers for this Los Angeles date only, making it one of the few stops with a third support act.

games.name: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again - Newark (Finale)
games.description: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again closes on December 21, 2026 at Prudential Center in Newark, a short drive from the brothers' native Wyckoff, New Jersey. The 47-date run opened with three nights at Madison Square Garden in August before a September restart in Boston. Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa support the finale, which follows the previous night's stop at UBS Arena.

games.name: Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival 2026
games.developer: Tyler, the Creator, Turnstile, Steve Lacy, Future, Don Toliver
games.description: Tyler, the Creator's Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival returns to the Dodger Stadium lot on November 14 and 15, 2026. Tyler headlines alongside Turnstile, Steve Lacy, Future and Don Toliver, with Vince Staples, Earl Sweatshirt, J.I.D, Lupe Fiasco, Isaiah Rashad, Wallows, Magdalena Bay, Lola Young and Syd also billed. Goldenvoice revealed the lineup as a set of word scrambles; passes sold out weeks earlier and only a waitlist remains.

games.name: TAEMIN: LiMiNaL World Tour - Los Angeles
games.description: SHINee's Taemin plays Crypto.com Arena on October 15, 2026 as part of the North American leg of his 2026-27 LiMiNaL World Tour. The six-city run opens October 12 at SAP Center in San Jose and finishes October 23 at Prudential Center in Newark, taking in Las Vegas, Grand Prairie and Chicago along the way. AEG is promoting the United States dates.

games.name: Steve Lacy: Oh yeah? Tour - New York
platforms: Radio City Music Hall, New York, NY
games.description: Steve Lacy makes his Radio City Music Hall debut on October 10, 2026 on the Oh yeah? Tour, his first headline run since 2022. The 27-city outing supports his third album Oh yeah?, released July 17 on RCA with guests including SZA, Erykah Badu and Tyler, the Creator. The tour opened September 27 in Minneapolis and runs through November 30 in Vancouver.

games.name: Steve Lacy: Oh yeah? Tour - Los Angeles
games.description: Steve Lacy headlines the Hollywood Bowl for the first time on November 21, 2026, one of three milestone venue debuts on his Oh yeah? Tour alongside Radio City Music Hall and Red Rocks. The Compton-raised singer and guitarist, once of The Internet, returns to a Los Angeles stage roughly a week after his billed appearance at Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival at Dodger Stadium.

games.name: Erykah Badu & The Alchemist: LIVE - A September Tour - Queens
games.developer: Erykah Badu, The Alchemist, De La Soul
games.description: Erykah Badu and producer The Alchemist play Forest Hills Stadium on September 18, 2026 with De La Soul opening. The short run, billed as LIVE: A September Tour, follows their joint album released August 28 through Control FREAQ and Young Recordings. The pair began working together on Badu's recent studio sessions, and the tour opened September 10 at Ravinia Festival outside Chicago.

games.name: Erykah Badu & The Alchemist: LIVE - A September Tour - Los Angeles (Finale)
games.description: Erykah Badu and The Alchemist close their LIVE: A September Tour at the Hollywood Bowl on September 29, 2026. Smino supports the Los Angeles date rather than De La Soul, who accompany most of the run. The tour marks the first extended live outing behind the duo's collaborative album, which arrived August 28 via Control FREAQ and Young Recordings.

games.name: The 8 Nights of Hanukkah with Yo La Tengo 2026
games.description: Yo La Tengo revive their Hanukkah residency at the Bowery Ballroom for eight consecutive nights from December 4 through December 11, 2026. Each evening pairs a surprise comedian with a surprise musical opener, and the Hoboken trio play a different set every night with no song repeated across the run, closing with an all-covers encore. Proceeds traditionally go to charities chosen by the band.

games.name: Jorja Smith: 2026 North American Tour - Brooklyn
games.description: Jorja Smith plays Kings Theatre in Brooklyn on November 21, 2026 as part of a five-date North American run behind her third album, What Are The Odds. The short tour opens November 14 at the Orpheum Theatre in Los Angeles and also visits San Francisco's Castro Theatre, Massey Hall in Toronto and the Riviera Theatre in Chicago before closing November 23.

games.name: Amon Amarth: The Allfather Awakens - Manchester
games.description: Amon Amarth launch The Allfather Awakens tour at the O2 Apollo in Manchester on October 9, 2026. Fellow Swedes Orbit Culture and Soilwork support the all-Swedish bill, which moves to London's Eventim Apollo and Wolverhampton Civic Hall before crossing to mainland Europe and ending November 15 in Lisbon. The band promise a new theatrical stage production and an extended headline set.

games.name: Remi Wolf - Mud
games.description: Remi Wolf releases her third studio album, Mud, on October 9, 2026 through Island Records. The eleven-track record follows 2024's Big Ideas and was pieced together across sessions in Nashville, Big Bear, New York and Joshua Tree with longtime collaborator Jared Solomon. Singles 'Bottle' and 'Twiggy' preceded the announcement, and the tracklist closes with 'Yellow Rose'.

games.name: Anderson .Paak & Cordae - Heavy Is the Crown
games.description: Anderson .Paak and Cordae release their joint album Heavy Is the Crown on October 23, 2026 via APESHIT, Mass Appeal and EMPIRE. The record extends a partnership that began with Cordae's 'RNP' and continued on 'Two Tens' and 'Summer Drop', and credits J. Cole, 9th Wonder, Conductor Williams and Swizz Beatz. Physical editions include six retailer-exclusive vinyl variants and a lenticular CD cover.

games.name: Wolves in the Throne Room - Estuary
games.description: Wolves in the Throne Room release Estuary, their tenth album, on October 23, 2026 through Relapse Records in North America. The Olympia black metal band recorded most of it at their own Owl Lodge studio, tracking drums at The Unknown, a converted church in Anacortes, Washington, and self-produced with touring bassist Galen Baudhuin. Lead single 'Ghosts Among the Obelisks' arrived with a video.

games.name: Wilco with Waxahatchee at Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Auditorium - Chattanooga
platforms: Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Auditorium, Chattanooga, TN
games.description: Wilco played Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Auditorium in Chattanooga on May 11, 2025, with Waxahatchee opening. Katie Crutchfield's set drew mostly on her 2024 album Tigers Blood before Wilco delivered a career-spanning headline performance in the 1924 hall. The show was part of the Chicago band's spring run through the American South and was promoted by Live Nation.

games.name: Eli Young Band: The Strange Hours Tour at The Regency Live - Springfield
games.developer: Eli Young Band, Bray, Joey Holt
games.description: Eli Young Band brought The Strange Hours Tour to The Regency Live in downtown Springfield, Missouri on December 11, 2025. Doors opened at 7pm for the all-ages show, which started at 8pm with local acts Bray and Joey Holt opening. The Texas quartet drew on their album Strange Hours, released that August, alongside earlier number ones such as 'Crazy Girl' and 'Drunk Last Night'.

games.name: The R&B Tour: Usher & Chris Brown - East Rutherford
games.developer: Usher, Chris Brown, Mario, Eric Bellinger, Tank
games.description: Usher and Chris Brown bring The R&B Tour to MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford on October 15, 2026, one of eight stadium dates added in August after the co-headline run sold out its opening stretch. Instead of separate headline sets, the two singers alternate across nine cinematic acts in a nearly three-hour production, joined onstage by Mario, Eric Bellinger and Tank. Live Nation produces the 59-date trek.

games.name: The R&B Tour: Usher & Chris Brown - Los Angeles
games.developer: Usher, Chris Brown, Mario, Eric Bellinger, Tank
games.description: Usher and Chris Brown close their Los Angeles run with a fourth SoFi Stadium show on November 16, 2026, added after the first three dates sold quickly. The Live Nation production runs close to three hours and trades the two catalogues back and forth across nine staged acts, with Mario, Eric Bellinger and Tank performing alongside them and segments paying tribute to Prince, Michael Jackson and Marvin Gaye.

games.name: The R&B Tour: Usher & Chris Brown - Atlanta
games.developer: Usher, Chris Brown, Mario, Eric Bellinger, Tank
games.description: Usher and Chris Brown open a five-night Atlanta stand at Mercedes-Benz Stadium on November 5, 2026, the newly added first date of a run that continues on November 6, 8, 10 and 11. The co-headline format alternates the pair across nine acts rather than back-to-back sets, with Mario, Eric Bellinger and Tank joining them. Live Nation produces the 59-show tour, which reaches Tampa in December.

games.name: The R&B Tour: Usher & Chris Brown - Indianapolis
games.developer: Usher, Chris Brown, Mario, Eric Bellinger, Tank
games.description: The R&B Tour makes its first Indianapolis stop at Lucas Oil Stadium on October 31, 2026, one of four brand-new cities added when Usher and Chris Brown extended the run to 59 dates. The nearly three-hour show moves between their catalogues across nine cinematic acts, backed by Mario, Eric Bellinger and Tank. Earlier legs set attendance and multi-night records in Detroit, Washington and Birmingham.

games.name: Nia Archives: Emotional World Tour - London
games.developer: Nia Archives, Cannelle, NEW YORK, Trickpony
games.description: Nia Archives plays Alexandra Palace on November 26, 2026, the London stop of the 19-date Emotional World Tour behind her Mercury Prize-shortlisted album Emotional Junglist. Cannelle, NEW YORK and Trickpony support. The run opens in Japan in September before crossing North America and Europe, and follows a summer of festival sets including a West Stage headline slot at All Points East. AEG Presents promotes the UK leg.

games.name: Neil Young & The Chrome Hearts and Willie Nelson & Family - Bridgeport
games.developer: Neil Young & The Chrome Hearts, Willie Nelson & Family, Ty Myers
games.description: Neil Young and Willie Nelson share a bill at the Hartford HealthCare Amphitheater in Bridgeport on September 22, 2026, the first of two co-headline dates announced in August. Young performs with The Chrome Hearts, the band he began touring with in late 2024, and Ty Myers opens. The pairing arrives as Nelson's Outlaw Music Festival run winds down and ahead of both artists' Farm Aid appearances.

games.name: Neil Young & The Chrome Hearts and Willie Nelson & Family - Philadelphia
platforms: Highmark Mann Center for the Performing Arts, Philadelphia, PA
games.developer: Neil Young & The Chrome Hearts, Willie Nelson & Family, Ty Myers
games.description: The second of two Neil Young and Willie Nelson co-headline concerts lands at the Highmark Mann Center for the Performing Arts in Philadelphia on September 24, 2026. Young is backed by The Chrome Hearts and Nelson by Family, with Ty Myers supporting both nights. Young scrapped his 2026 European dates earlier in the year, making this short East Coast pair his main run of the autumn.

games.name: Oso Oso: An Exchange of Information Tour - Allston
games.developer: Oso Oso, Leisure Hour, Bad Luck
games.description: Jade Lilitri's Oso Oso opens a 32-date North American headline run at Brighton Music Hall in Allston on October 7, 2026. Leisure Hour and Bad Luck support the eastern leg, which works down the coast and through the Midwest before wrapping in Washington on October 25. A second leg with Liquid Mike and Bugsy picks up in Columbus in November and ends in St. Louis.

games.name: Oso Oso: An Exchange of Information Tour - Los Angeles
games.description: Oso Oso reach the Teragram Ballroom in Los Angeles on November 15, 2026, part of the western leg of a 32-date North American tour. Liquid Mike and Bugsy open every show on this stretch, which runs from Columbus in early November through Denver, Seattle and Portland before turning south. The band's earlier October dates were supported by Leisure Hour and Bad Luck.

games.name: Basement: WIRED Tour 2027 - London
games.description: Basement headline the Roundhouse in Camden on February 18, 2027, the biggest London date of a 15-show UK and European run behind WIRED, the band's first album in more than eight years. Fleshwater and Beton Arme open throughout. The tour starts in Amsterdam on February 2 and takes in Brussels, Berlin, Cologne, Birmingham, Glasgow and Manchester before finishing in Dublin.

games.name: Fontaines D.C. - Dopamine Chamber
games.description: Fontaines D.C. release their fifth studio album, Dopamine Chamber, on October 16, 2026 through XL Recordings. James Ford returns as producer after working on 2024's Romance, and the record was announced alongside the expansive lead single 'Marianne'. It follows the Dublin band's breakout run of arena shows and festival headline slots, and pre-orders include coloured vinyl pressings through the label and independent shops.

games.name: Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival 2025
games.developer: Tyler, the Creator, Childish Gambino, A$AP Rocky, Doechii, Kali Uchis
games.description: Tyler, the Creator's eleventh Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival took over the Dodger Stadium lot on November 22 and 23, 2025, a week later than planned after heavy rain forced a postponement. Clairo, Don Toliver, Men I Trust, Sombr, Tems and The Alchemist dropped off the rescheduled bill, and Kali Uchis, Blood Orange, Geese and Fakemink were added. Tyler headlined alongside Childish Gambino, A$AP Rocky, Clipse and Doechii.

games.name: 61st Jazzaldia - San Sebastian Jazz Festival 2026
games.developer: Diana Krall, Pat Metheny, Marcus Miller, Samara Joy, Nils Petter Molvaer
games.description: The 61st Jazzaldia ran from July 22 to 26, 2026 in San Sebastian, staging 77 concerts across twelve sites for a combined audience of 179,483. Diana Krall, Pat Metheny, Marcus Miller and Samara Joy each sold out the Kutxabank Kursaal Auditorium, where Nils Petter Molvaer also drew strong reviews. Organisers sold 16,272 tickets to buyers from 37 countries, and fifteen concerts sold out entirely.

games.name: Olivia Rodrigo: The Unraveled Tour - Philadelphia
games.description: Olivia Rodrigo brings The Unraveled Tour to Philadelphia for two nights at Xfinity Mobile Arena on November 7 and 8, 2026, with doors at 6:00 PM and both shows starting at 7:00 PM. The run supports her third album, You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love, released in June 2026. Devon Again opens the Philadelphia dates. The wider tour covers 86 shows across North America and Europe.

games.name: Olivia Rodrigo: The Unraveled Tour - London Residency
games.description: Olivia Rodrigo opens a UK-exclusive residency at The O2 in London on April 5, 2027, the only British stop on The Unraveled Tour. Demand pushed the booking to eleven nights, running through April and closing the entire world tour on May 10, 2027. Grace Ives supports the London shows. Tickets first went on sale through an O2 priority presale in May 2026 before the general on-sale.

games.name: Noah Kahan: The Last of the Bugs World Tour - UK & Ireland Stadiums
games.description: Noah Kahan steps up to stadiums in the UK and Ireland during July 2027, opening at Hampden Park in Glasgow on July 13 and playing Dublin's Aviva Stadium on July 17. He closes at Wembley Stadium in London on July 23, the biggest headline show of his career, with a second Wembley night added on July 24 after demand. The shows follow his second UK number one album, The Great Divide.

games.name: Stand Up for Heroes 2026: 20th Anniversary
platforms: David Geffen Hall, New York, NY
games.developer: Bruce Springsteen, Jon Stewart, Hasan Minhaj, Josh Johnson, Alex Warren, The Resilient
games.description: The Bob Woodruff Foundation marks twenty years of Stand Up for Heroes on November 9, 2026 at David Geffen Hall in New York's Lincoln Center. Bruce Springsteen headlines the music and comedy benefit, which he has played at nearly every edition since 2007. Jon Stewart, Hasan Minhaj and Josh Johnson handle the comedy, with additional performances from Alex Warren and veteran group The Resilient. The series has raised more than 117 million dollars for injured veterans.

games.name: Lindsey Stirling: Snow Waltz Holiday Tour 2026
games.description: Lindsey Stirling launches her 25-city Snow Waltz Holiday Tour on November 18, 2026 at Hard Rock Live in Hollywood, Florida. The theatrical production pairs her violin playing with dance and staging built around holiday material, then works north and west through Syracuse, Philadelphia, St. Louis and Tucson, including a three-night stand in Las Vegas, before finishing in Texas on December 23. Electroacoustic duo ARKAI supports every date.

games.name: Down - Volume V
games.description: New Orleans metal group Down release Volume V on November 20, 2026 through Nuclear Blast Records, their first full-length album in twelve years. The ten-track record is led by the single Blood Oath, on which Phil Anselmo trades vocals with King Diamond. Other titles include The Myth, Merciful Fate, Causeway Grief and Twice-Told Tales. Nuclear Blast issues the album on CD, digital and double vinyl, with seven vinyl variants including retailer exclusives.

games.name: Beyond The Music 2026
games.developer: Kofi Stone, Lady Ice, Bawo, OneDa, Mouth Ulcers, ALT BLK ERA
games.description: Beyond The Music returns for a third edition from October 7 to 9, 2026, moving from central Manchester to MediaCity in Salford. The combined festival and industry conference spreads across the MediaCity campus and wider Salford, using outdoor stages, dock10 studios, disused shop units and established local venues. Birmingham rapper Kofi Stone leads the first announced wave alongside Lady Ice, Bawo and OneDa, part of a showcase covering more than one hundred emerging artists.

games.name: Kendrick Lamar & SZA: Grand National Tour - Atlanta
games.description: Kendrick Lamar and SZA played Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta on April 29, 2025, an early stop on their co-headlining Grand National Tour. The pair alternated solo segments and combined for their joint recordings, drawing on Lamar's GNX material and SZA's SOS catalogue. The stadium run was one of the highest grossing tours of that year and marked the largest Atlanta headline appearance either artist had staged.

games.name: ZHU: 360 In The Round - London
games.description: ZHU performed at the Roundhouse in Camden on July 18, 2026, billed as a rare 360 In The Round staging inside the Grade II listed Victorian building. The Roundhouse later confirmed the layout had reverted to a traditional stage configuration while keeping the bespoke production. The producer, who first surfaced anonymously in 2014 before the Grammy-nominated Faded, had sold out each of his previous London appearances.

games.name: "Weird Al" Yankovic: Bigger & Weirder Tour - Bridgeport
games.description: "Weird Al" Yankovic played the Hartford HealthCare Amphitheater in Bridgeport, Connecticut on August 25, 2026 as part of the Bigger & Weirder Tour. The show landed in a busy late-August stretch at the waterfront venue, which also hosted The Fray with Dashboard Confessional on August 23 and Brad Paisley on August 27. Yankovic's touring production leans on costume changes and full-band arrangements of his parody catalogue.

games.name: Shakira: Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour - Madrid Residency Opening Night
games.description: Shakira opens a twelve-night European residency at Iberdrola Music in the Villaverde district of Madrid on September 18, 2026, her first Spanish concert in eight years. The promoter has built a temporary arena billed as Shakira Stadium for the run, holding more than 50,000 people a night. The residency closes out her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour and runs alongside a Latin culture programme called Es Latina.

games.name: Shakira: Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour - Madrid Residency Final Night
games.description: The twelfth and final night of Shakira's Madrid residency falls on October 11, 2026 at Iberdrola Music, bringing the Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour to a close. The residency is spread across four weekends in September and October, with shows on the 18th, 19th, 20th, 25th, 26th and 27th of September and the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 9th, 10th and 11th of October. Each night uses a purpose-built 50,000-capacity temporary stadium.

games.name: KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR - London
games.description: KATSEYE play the second of two nights at The O2 arena in London on September 4, 2026, part of the group's first headline arena run. The Wildworld Tour opened September 1 in Dublin and supports the HYBE x Geffen EP 'WILD'. The London shows were added after the original single date sold out, with doors at 6:30pm and a 16-plus restriction on floor tickets.

games.name: KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR - Belmont Park
games.description: KATSEYE bring The Wildworld Tour to UBS Arena in Belmont Park, New York on October 24, 2026, the first of two consecutive nights at the Long Island venue. The North American leg opens October 13 in Miami and runs through late November, ending in Mexico City. Tickets went on general sale in May 2026 and several dates sold out quickly.

games.name: KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR - Oakland
games.description: KATSEYE play Oakland Arena on November 19, 2026 as the Wildworld Tour reaches Northern California. The date sits between stops in Seattle and Los Angeles on a West Coast run that closes the group's first North American arena tour. The show supports 'WILD', the third EP from the Los Angeles-based group formed through HYBE and Geffen's Dream Academy programme.

games.name: KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR - Los Angeles
games.description: KATSEYE headline Crypto.com Arena on November 21, 2026, the first of two hometown nights in Los Angeles near the end of the Wildworld Tour. The group is based in Los Angeles, making the pair of arena shows the largest headline dates they have played in the city. Two further shows in Mexico City close the tour the following week.

games.name: Rush: Fifty Something Tour - Houston
games.description: Rush added Houston's Toyota Center on October 1, 2026 as one of four new single-night stops on the Fifty Something Tour, announced in late August. The reunion run marks the band's return to the road with Anika Nilles on drums. General tickets and VIP packages for the four added shows go on sale September 4, 2026 at 10am local time through Ticketmaster.

games.name: Rush: Fifty Something Tour - Pittsburgh
games.description: Rush play PPG Paints Arena in Pittsburgh on November 15, 2026, the latest of four cities added to the Fifty Something Tour in August 2026. The other additions are Houston on October 1, St. Louis on October 21 and Cincinnati on October 23. The tour was already routed into April 2027 before the band found room for the extra fall dates.

games.name: Fontaines D.C. at Slane Castle 2027
games.developer: Fontaines D.C., Hayley Williams, Damien Dempsey, Madra Salach
games.description: Fontaines D.C. headline Slane Castle in County Meath on June 26, 2027, the largest show of the Dublin band's career at a site with capacity for around 80,000. Hayley Williams, Damien Dempsey and Madra Salach are among the announced support acts. The band become only the third Irish act to headline Slane, after U2 and Thin Lizzy. General sale opened September 3, 2026.

games.name: Fontaines D.C. at Slane Castle 2027 - Second Night
games.developer: Fontaines D.C., Hayley Williams, Damien Dempsey, Madra Salach
games.description: A second Slane Castle date was added on September 2, 2026 after demand for the original show, putting Fontaines D.C. on the County Meath hillside on Sunday June 27, 2027 as well as the Saturday. Back-to-back nights at Slane are rare; the venue normally hosts a single concert per year. The same bill of guests is expected across both days.

games.name: Neighbourhood Weekender 2027
games.description: Neighbourhood Weekender returns to Victoria Park in Warrington on May 29 and 30, 2027, with the line-up revealed unusually early in September 2026. Paul Heaton, joined by guest vocalist Rianne Downey, and The Reytons co-headline the Saturday, and Courteeners close the festival on the Sunday. Rick Astley plays a hometown set, and the Sunday hosts the festival's first Hacienda Presents takeover with Graeme Park and K-Klass.

games.name: Melanie Martinez: HADES - THE SACRIFICE - London
games.description: Melanie Martinez brings the HADES: THE SACRIFICE tour to The O2 arena in London on September 11, 2026. The run supports her fourth album 'Hades', released in March 2026, and introduces a new alter ego named Circle. Martinez has described the staging as cinematic, leaning on practical effects and camera illusions rather than the puppetry of earlier tours. Doors open at 6:30pm.

games.name: The Pussycat Dolls: PCD Forever Tour - London
games.developer: The Pussycat Dolls, Lil' Kim, Deja Vu
games.description: The Pussycat Dolls close the European leg of their PCD Forever reunion tour at The O2 arena in London on October 13, 2026, with Lil' Kim and Deja Vu as special guests. The group reformed in 2026 as a trio of Nicole Scherzinger, Ashley Roberts and Kimberly Wyatt, releasing the single 'Club Song'. The wider tour spans 53 dates across the UK, Europe and North America.

games.name: aespa LIVE TOUR - SYNK : Complaexity - London
games.description: aespa play The O2 arena in London on January 16, 2027 on the 2026-27 SYNK : Complaexity world tour. The group precede the London date with a stop at Manchester's AO Arena on January 14 before the European leg continues to Amsterdam, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Berlin, Milan, Barcelona and Paris. The production is billed as a full rebuild rather than a revival of the earlier SYNK : aeXIS LINE staging.

games.name: Angèle - Instinct
games.description: Belgian singer Angèle releases her third studio album 'Instinct' on October 16, 2026 through Angèle VL Records and Sony Music. The thirteen-track record is her first full-length since 'Nonante-Cinq' in 2021 and features contributions from Justice, Soulwax, Caroline Polachek and SebastiAn. The lead single 'Une seule vie' arrived ahead of the announcement, and the album is framed around movement and letting go.

games.name: Lana Del Rey: 2025 UK and Ireland Tour - Glasgow
games.description: Lana Del Rey played a sold-out Hampden Park in Glasgow on June 26, 2025 during her first all-stadium tour. BANKS opened at 7:30pm and Del Rey took the stage at 9:20pm at the 50,000-capacity Scottish national stadium. The UK and Ireland run started in Cardiff on June 23 and finished in London on July 4, and reviewers described the Glasgow set as theatrical but restrained.

games.name: Turnstile: The Never Enough Tour - Philadelphia
platforms: Highmark Mann Center for the Performing Arts(Highmark Skyline Stage), Philadelphia, PA
games.developer: Turnstile, Mannequin Pussy, Speed, Jane Remover
games.description: Turnstile headlined the Highmark Skyline Stage at the Mann Center in Philadelphia on September 19, 2025 on The Never Enough Tour. Mannequin Pussy, Speed and Jane Remover filled out the bill. The Baltimore band opened with the title track from 'Never Enough' and worked through Seein' Stars, Blackout, Holiday and T.L.C., with local reviewers noting how the newer material widened the group's hardcore foundation.

games.name: blink-182: Missionary Impossible Tour - Hollywood, FL
games.developer: blink-182, Alkaline Trio, Beauty School Dropout
games.description: blink-182 opened the Missionary Impossible tour at Hard Rock Live inside the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino in Hollywood, Florida on August 28, 2025. Alkaline Trio and Beauty School Dropout supported. The band played a 24-song set that reached back through the catalogue and closed with What's My Age Again, All the Small Things and Dammit. The tour ran until October 19 in Las Vegas.

games.name: Ty Segall: Possession Tour - Los Angeles
games.description: Ty Segall played the Teragram Ballroom in Los Angeles on October 6, 2025 in support of his album 'Possession'. The show was a rescheduled version of a date originally set for The Bellwether on October 10, and existing tickets were honoured. The set drew across his catalogue, opening with Possession and taking in Love Fuzz, Hello Hi, Harmonizer, Melted and The Bell.

games.name: Billy Joel & Sting: Two Icons - One Night - Indianapolis
games.description: Billy Joel and Sting co-headlined Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis on February 8, 2025 as part of the Two Icons - One Night stadium run. Sting opened the evening with a set that included If I Ever Lose My Faith in You, Englishman in New York, Fragile and Every Breath You Take before Joel closed the night. The show was one of the last Joel played before postponing his 2025 dates.

games.name: All Time Low: Boston Calling After Party - Allston
games.description: All Time Low played an 18-plus Boston Calling after party at Brighton Music Hall in Allston on May 23, 2025, a club show far smaller than the festival stage they had worked earlier the same day. The set ran roughly ninety minutes at the 500-capacity Allston room, which has operated as a Crossroads Presents venue since opening in 2010.
